Your CruxCoach account works fundamentally different from traditional accounts: Instead of registering with an email and password at a company, you own a cryptographic key. This key is your account — whoever holds it has access. No company can lock, delete, or read your data. Messages to the developer are end-to-end encrypted. The trade-off: you are responsible for your key. If lost, nobody can reset it for you. Technically, your account is built on the open Nostr protocol.

This will hide your backup behind a deletion marker on every index server, and request the encrypted backup data to be removed from every storage server. After this:

• No device — yours or anyone else's — can restore the backup, even if a storage server still holds the encrypted bytes.
• Storage-server cleanup is best-effort. A partial result (e.g. 1/2 servers) is not a privacy issue: the deletion marker is what guarantees the backup is unrecoverable.
• Local data on this device is not affected.

Note: backup servers (Nostr relays + Blossom CDNs under the hood) can propagate or cache content before deletion. Third-party mirrors you never wrote to may still hold a copy — for full certainty, check with a Nostr client against your published pubkey.

Beyond Kilter, 0.2.0 adds full MoonBoard support and the Aurora boards — Tension, Grasshopper, Decoy, So iLL and Touchstone. Browse each catalogue with the same grade, angle and setter filters, and light up boulders on your board over Bluetooth.
Also new: a worldwide board-locations map and a find-your-gym board picker — both in Settings.

• Zone search — in the hold search, drag a frame on the board photo and find every climb that lives entirely inside it.

• Kilter playlists arrive as lists — logging in with your Kilter account now also imports your playlists.

• Share any climb — every climb gets a link that opens straight in CruxCoach.

• Lists across boards — saved lists now show all your climbs, each with its board badge and a board filter.
Easy to miss in 0.2.0: MoonBoard and the Aurora boards (Tension, Grasshopper and more), a worldwide board map and a find-your-gym picker — all in Settings.

• Play your lists — one climb at a time, with rests, one-tap logging and a summary at the end. Or let CruxCoach plan the session from your logbook.

• CruxRelay — share your board so that everyone in the session can send from their own phone.

• Two more MoonBoards (2010 and Mini 2025), problems that say when they are meant to be climbed footless, and a climb that stays lit while you work it.

• Tap your last board to reconnect, choose when a climb goes to the wall, and get app updates from more than one download source.
Automatic installation is off by default. Choose your preferred update behavior in Settings.

• Competitions — run a comp on your board, or take part in one, with no account and no server. The whole competition lives on Nostr, and every client replays it to the same standings.

• Join by scanning the organiser’s QR code with CruxCoach, by opening their link, or by pasting it.

• Whose turn it is, how many climbers are ahead of you, how many attempts you have left, and where you stand — in that order.

• Where the organiser charges an entry fee, you can pay it in the app over Lightning.
Competitions live behind the CruxCoach logo in the board browser\u2019s top bar. Android 9 or newer is required from this release on.

0.2.0 also adds the Aurora-family boards — Tension, Grasshopper, Decoy, So iLL and Touchstone — alongside Kilter and MoonBoard. Browse each board\'s catalogue with the same grade, angle and setter filters, open a climb, and light it up on your board over Bluetooth.
Pick your board in Settings → board type. Its catalogue downloads on first selection; the board-fit filter and the locations map work for these boards too.

0.2.0 puts every known Kilter and MoonBoard installation on an interactive world map. Tap the map icon next to hold-search in the board browser, pan around, tap a marker for the gym\'s address, phone, email, and a direct link into the climbs for that board\'s exact layout and size.

Filters cover board brand, layout family, country, public-vs-private, adjustability and size. The \"Matches my board\" filter narrows the markers to gyms whose hardware fits the board you configured in Settings.
New: pick your board by gym
In Settings → Board size, \"Change\" now offers a \"Find gym\" path. Search your gym, pick the wall, done — no more guessing the product-size code from the dropdown.
The manual list is still there as a fallback for setters and home-wall owners who know their hardware off the top of their head.
Migrate from Aurora / old Kilter app
Bring your ascents, attempts and playlists across from the email export Aurora sends after a data request.

Aurora Climbing took its API offline in early 2026 and the official Kilter app moved to a new backend. Aurora still honours one-time data-export requests by email — the file they send is what this importer reads.
Email Aurora support and ask for a copy of your data. They\'ll reply with a single JSON file (usually within a couple of days).
